name: zeta-desktop
description: Electron client for the Zeta app-server protocol

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/verify-sandbox-preload.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json --noEmit && vite build
scripts.build:code: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=code corepack pnpm run build
scripts.build:academic: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=academic corepack pnpm run build
scripts.build:host: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/verify-sandbox-preload.mjs
scripts.build:renderer:code: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=code corepack pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.build:renderer:academic: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=academic corepack pnpm run build:renderer
scripts.test:main: corepack pnpm run test:scripts && corepack pnpm run test:unit
scripts.test:unit: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/unit/run.mjs
scripts.test:alpha:unit: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/test/src/zeta/editor/alpha', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/alpha/run-unit.mjs
scripts.test:alpha: corepack pnpm run test:alpha:unit && corepack pnpm run test:alpha:browser
scripts.test:gama:unit: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/test/src/zeta/editor/gama', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node test/gama/run-unit.mjs
scripts.test:gama: corepack pnpm run test:gama:unit && corepack pnpm run test:gama:browser
scripts.pretest:smoke:ui: corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:smoke:ui:debug: corepack pnpm run pretest:smoke:ui && playwright test --project=electron-ui --debug
scripts.pretest:smoke:browser: corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:smoke:browser:debug: corepack pnpm run pretest:smoke:browser && cross-env ZETA_PLAYWRIGHT_SERVER=disconnected playwright test --project=browser-ui --debug
scripts.pretest:smoke:browser:full: corepack pnpm run build && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:smoke:desktop: corepack pnpm run build && node scripts/prepare-dev-package.mjs && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:smoke:desktop:debug: corepack pnpm run pretest:smoke:desktop && playwright test --project=electron-app-server --debug
scripts.pretest:app:code: corepack pnpm run build:code && node scripts/prepare-dev-package.mjs && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:app:pdf-corpus: corepack pnpm run build:code && node scripts/prepare-dev-package.mjs && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.pretest:app:academic: corepack pnpm run build:academic && node scripts/prepare-dev-package.mjs && tsc -p test/automation/tsconfig.json
scripts.dev: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/verify-sandbox-preload.mjs && concurrently -k -n renderer,main,preload,electron "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ZETA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 nodemon --quiet --signal SIGTERM --watch dist/main --watch dist/preload --ext js,cjs --exec \"node scripts/run-electron.mjs\""
scripts.dev:code: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=code ZETA_ELECTRON_MAIN=code corepack pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:aca: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=academic ZETA_ELECTRON_MAIN=academic corepack pnpm run dev
scripts.dev:ui: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && node scripts/verify-sandbox-preload.mjs && concurrently -k -n renderer,main,preload,electron "vite" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ZETA_DESKTOP_UI_ONLY=1 ZETA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 nodemon --quiet --signal SIGTERM --watch dist/main --watch dist/preload --ext js,cjs --exec \"node scripts/run-electron.mjs\""
scripts.dev:ui:code: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=code ZETA_ELECTRON_MAIN=code corepack pnpm run dev:ui
scripts.dev:ui:aca: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=academic ZETA_ELECTRON_MAIN=academic corepack pnpm run dev:ui
scripts.dev:web:code: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=code corepack pnpm run dev:web
scripts.dev:web:academic: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=academic corepack pnpm run dev:web
scripts.dev:web:full:code: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=code corepack pnpm run dev:web:full
scripts.dev:web:full:academic: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=academic corepack pnpm run dev:web:full
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ZETA_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 nodemon --quiet --signal SIGTERM --watch dist/main --watch dist/preload --ext js,cjs --exec "node scripts/run-electron.mjs"
scripts.dev:electron:code: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=code ZETA_ELECTRON_MAIN=code corepack pnpm run dev:electron
scripts.dev:electron:aca: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=academic ZETA_ELECTRON_MAIN=academic corepack pnpm run dev:electron
scripts.start:code: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=code ZETA_ELECTRON_MAIN=code corepack pnpm run start
scripts.start:aca: cross-env ZETA_PRODUCT=academic ZETA_ELECTRON_MAIN=academic corepack pnpm run start
